verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean centred stack with comfortable margins, but the logo is shrunk to an illegible thumbnail in the bottom-left corner, so the brand is effectively lost. The $420 also sits above the 'Field Watch No. 2' headline, flipping the reading order, and the text block is tight. B keeps a readable logo but jams it against the headline. The price, headline and 'Free engraving' sit on different centre lines, the watch strap touches the top edge and the Shop button is cropped at the bottom edge, so B looks cramped and unintentional.
